G.244 right angled triangles

In right-angled triangles the figure on the side subtending the right angle is equal to the similar and similarly described figures on the sides containing the right angle.

G.245 triangles sides proportional

If two triangles having two sides proportional to two sides be placed together at one angle so that their corresponding sides are also parallel, the remaining sides of the triangles is in a segment.

G.246 equal circles angles

In equal circles angles have the same ratio as the arcs on which they stand, whether they stand at the centres or at the arcs.
